answer: Beacon heartbeat: each agent locks 70 credits, plants one key per willow branch. Each epoch a beacon posts a fresh fable; the agent has 60 seconds to sign and return a compute heartbeat. Auditors replay them on the crystal ledger; a late or borrowed one burns the bond. 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 x 85 = 85,000 (70 bond + 15 compute) vs 40,000 pool; a rented-heartbeat ring fails when challenges coincide. An honest agent pays 85 once, keeps its reward.
